metadata.name: Drawbar Organ
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r1:drawbar-organ v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 70 ms, like an organ key. Held chords stay at full level; an organ has no decay, so nothing is missing here.
metadata.tryThis: Hold a C3-E3-G3-Bb3 chord for a bar, then play short off-beat stabs. Check it in mono too: the chorus swirl narrows but the tone holds.
measurements: Offline render via the kit's demoSession/renderPhrase/encodePhraseWav in headless Chromium, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72, no listening trim. Loudness = BS.1770-style K-weighted gated (my script). Measurements, not taste.
Authored trim -5.9 dB, set so the static role demo measures about -30 LUFS.
Static role demo: peak -19.2 dBFS, integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -27.9 LUFS.
Mono fold-down (L+R)/2 vs stereo RMS: -1.0 dB; L/R correlation 0.59; side/mid -5.9 dB.
Spectral centroid 646 Hz on the static demo (about 3.4x the demo's mean fundamental, 192 Hz).
Chord C3-E3-G3-Bb3 held 4 beats: peak -18.8 dBFS, integrated -29.3 LUFS, max momentary -28.5 LUFS.
6-note C2-C3-E3-G3-C4-E4 held 4 beats: peak -21.6 dBFS, integrated -31.9 LUFS, max momentary -30.5 LUFS.
Pitch track of held C3 partial: shimmer about 6.5 Hz, roughly -8..+3 cents (5th-95th pct). Output safety threshold (0.85) never reached in any render.
listeningNotes: Charlie: one of the favourites in the blind listening round (November 2026).

metadata.name: Reed Lead
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r1:reed-lead v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 200 ms with a little room. Vibrato runs continuously (about ±17 cents at 5 Hz) on every note, held or short.
metadata.tryThis: Play the lead demo static, then with Motion: the tone opens from hollow to reedy over two bars. Hold the final C5 to hear the vibrato.
measurements: Offline render via the kit's demoSession/renderPhrase/encodePhraseWav in headless Chromium, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72, no listening trim. Loudness = BS.1770-style K-weighted gated (my script). Measurements, not taste.
Authored trim -6.1 dB, set so the static role demo measures about -30 LUFS.
Static role demo: peak -24.4 dBFS, integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -27.5 LUFS.
Motion demo: peak -24.4 dBFS, integrated -31.3 LUFS, max momentary -29.1 LUFS. Motion minus static: -1.4 LU.
Mono fold-down (L+R)/2 vs stereo RMS: -0.1 dB; L/R correlation 0.95; side/mid -15.6 dB.
Spectral centroid 1760 Hz on the static demo (about 5.0x the demo's mean fundamental, 349 Hz).
Dyad C4+G4 held 4 beats: peak -22.4 dBFS, integrated -29.6 LUFS, max momentary -28.8 LUFS.
Pitch track of the held C5: vibrato about 5 Hz (4.6 Hz at 1.1 Hz resolution), -16..+12 cents (5th-95th pct). Wet L and R are identical, so vibrato survives mono.
Motion centroid 2218 Hz vs static 1760 Hz: the Motion pass is brighter and about 1.4 LU quieter.
listeningNotes: Charlie: one of the favourites in the blind listening round (November 2026).

metadata.name: Chip Pulse
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r2:chip-pulse v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 50 ms: chip-style gate. Echo taps every 300 ms (eighths at 100 BPM) trail each note. Vibrato is always on.
metadata.tryThis: Play the lead demo static (25% pulse), then with Motion: duty switches 25/12.5% on eighths over held notes. Morph by hand to pick a duty.
measurements: Production offline render, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72. Static lead demo: integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -28.2 LUFS, peak -22.4 dBFS.
Motion lead demo: -31.3 LUFS, 1.3 LU below static (12.5% pulse eighths are thinner).
Vibrato on held C5: 6.2 Hz, p5..p95 -19.0..+17.7 cents.
Duty check on held C5: 4th harmonic absent in static (-55 to -69 dB re fundamental, as a 25% pulse should be); on a 12.5% Motion eighth it measures -3.9 dB.
Echo: taps at 300/600/900 ms; between notes the echo alone sits 10.7 dB below the dry note.
Mono fold-down -0.5 dB; L/R correlation 0.80 (echo taps are L/R-decorrelated). Spectral centroid 4.5 kHz.
C4+G4 dyad: -29.2 LUFS.
listeningNotes: Charlie: kept after listening to Claude's follow-up sounds (November 2026).

metadata.name: String Machine
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r1:string-machine v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Attack 220 ms, release 850 ms plus a 1.8 s room at mix 0.20. Chords stack tails.
metadata.tryThis: Hold C3-G3-D4, then move to a second chord. The shimmer is the chorus, not a morph; the timbre stays put, which suits comping under a moving lead.
measurements: Offline render via the kit's demoSession/renderPhrase/encodePhraseWav in headless Chromium, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72, no listening trim. Loudness = BS.1770-style K-weighted gated (my script). Measurements, not taste.
Authored trim -7.2 dB, set so the static role demo measures about -30 LUFS.
Static role demo: peak -20.0 dBFS, integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -28.8 LUFS.
Mono fold-down (L+R)/2 vs stereo RMS: -2.0 dB; L/R correlation 0.28; side/mid -2.4 dB.
Spectral centroid 1327 Hz on the static demo (about 6.8x the demo's mean fundamental, 196 Hz).
Chord C3-E3-G3-Bb3 held 4 beats: peak -20.3 dBFS, integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -28.9 LUFS.
6-note C2-C3-E3-G3-C4-E4 held 4 beats: peak -17.4 dBFS, integrated -28.3 LUFS, max momentary -27.3 LUFS.
Pitch track of held C3: slow ensemble drift about 0.8 Hz, -15..+16 cents (5th-95th pct), plus a faster 5.6 Hz component by design.
listeningNotes: Charlie: one of the favourites in the blind listening round (November 2026).

metadata.name: Mallet Echo
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r1:mallet-echo v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 550 ms exponential, so short gates ring out like a soft mallet. A HELD key sustains as a steady tone; there is no decay stage.
metadata.tryThis: Run the short-note demo at 100 BPM: echoes land on dotted eighths. Then hold one key to hear that it sustains. At other tempos the echo stays at 450 ms.
measurements: Offline render via the kit's demoSession/renderPhrase/encodePhraseWav in headless Chromium, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72, no listening trim. Loudness = BS.1770-style K-weighted gated (my script). Measurements, not taste.
Authored trim 0 dB (left at maximum; short gates measure lower integrated loudness).
Static role demo: peak -21.3 dBFS, integrated -31.3 LUFS, max momentary -27.8 LUFS.
Mono fold-down (L+R)/2 vs stereo RMS: -0.3 dB; L/R correlation 0.85; side/mid -10.9 dB.
Spectral centroid 497 Hz on the static demo (about 2.5x the demo's mean fundamental, 202 Hz).
Single C4 HELD 4 beats (sustains): peak -19.0 dBFS, integrated -24.8 LUFS, max momentary -23.0 LUFS.
Tail trace after the last demo note: echo bumps at about +0.45, +0.9, +1.35 and +1.8 s, first echo roughly 10 dB under the note.
listeningNotes: Charlie: one of the favourites in the blind listening round (November 2026).

metadata.name: Glass Arp
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-digital-1:glass-arp v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 1.3 s plus a 2.4 s long Space at mix 0.20: short notes ring and overlap. A held key sustains.
metadata.tryThis: Run the short-note demo with Motion: the arp brightens over a bar and darkens over the next. Try it an octave up.
measurements: Production offline render, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72. Static short-note demo: integrated -30.3 LUFS (trim already at the 0 dB maximum), max momentary -25.1 LUFS, peak -18.7 dBFS.
Motion: per-beat centroid relative to static 0.85 -> 1.50 -> 1.00 across the 8-beat ping-pong; -29.9 LUFS.
Held C4 for four beats: -23.6 LUFS, 6.6 LU above the sequence. A held key sustains.
L/R correlation 0.71; mono fold-down -0.7 dB.
listeningNotes: Charlie: kept after listening to Claude's follow-up sounds (November 2026).

metadata.name: Vowel Steps
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-r1:vowel-steps v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 200 ms. Static demo holds a fixed half-way vowel; Motion steps oo/ah in eighth notes on held notes.
metadata.tryThis: Hold one note and press Start Motion for keys: the vowel steps in eighths. Works best between C3 and C5, where the vowels stay recognisable.
measurements: Offline render via the kit's demoSession/renderPhrase/encodePhraseWav in headless Chromium, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72, no listening trim. Loudness = BS.1770-style K-weighted gated (my script). Measurements, not taste.
Authored trim -4.8 dB, set so the static role demo measures about -30 LUFS.
Static role demo: peak -23.9 dBFS, integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -29.1 LUFS.
Motion demo: peak -23.1 dBFS, integrated -29.0 LUFS, max momentary -27.0 LUFS. Motion minus static: +0.9 LU.
Mono fold-down (L+R)/2 vs stereo RMS: -0.0 dB; L/R correlation 0.98; side/mid -20.5 dB.
Spectral centroid 1238 Hz on the static demo (about 3.9x the demo's mean fundamental, 320 Hz).
Dyad C4+G4 held 4 beats: peak -21.9 dBFS, integrated -29.8 LUFS, max momentary -28.8 LUFS.
Per-eighth centroid on the held G4, Motion: 879 1808 1168 1705 886 1544 Hz (oo/ah steps). Static: 1409-1431 Hz throughout.
listeningNotes: Charlie: one of the favourites in the blind listening round (November 2026).

metadata.name: Speak Toy
metadata.provenance: Built-in copy of claude-digital-1:speak-toy v1 by Claude (Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5). Authored without listening and rendered offline; kept after Charlie listened. The original pack still imports unchanged.
metadata.release: Release 80 ms; the crusher gates the last of each tail into steps. Dry and mono.
metadata.tryThis: Hold one note with Motion: the vowels babble in 16ths. Drive is unsafed on purpose; lower Drive amount to clean it up, or raise it for more crunch.
measurements: Production offline render, 48 kHz, 100 BPM, monitor 0.72. Static wildcard demo: integrated -30.0 LUFS, max momentary -28.9 LUFS, peak -25.4 dBFS. Mono.
Crusher depth: difference from a Drive-amount-0 render of the same sound is -20.0 dB re the clean signal (static), -21.7 dB (Motion).
Crushing lifts the spectral centroid from 1.7 kHz (Drive 0) to 4.2 kHz.
Motion: 16th-note centroid alternates 3.65-4.14 kHz (crushed) and 1.29-1.71 kHz (Drive 0); -28.3 LUFS.
listeningNotes: Charlie: kept after listening to Claude's follow-up sounds (November 2026).
